## Change and reason

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Verification

List the automated checks and manual flows you ran, with results. Include the
Unity version, platform, and roles where relevant. Explain omitted checks and
remaining limitations. Release CI runs focused versioning tests, not the full suite.

## Visible changes

For UI or gameplay presentation changes, add screenshots or a short recording.
Remove this section when it does not apply.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes matching `.meta` files for Unity asset changes.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated, or the reason they are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] No credentials, local settings, generated Unity folders, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have compatible licenses and required notices, or none were added.

## Limitations or migration

Describe setup changes, compatibility requirements, known limitations, or follow-up work.
Remove this section when it does not apply.
